sources.title: FWKV — Simplicity Is All You Need
sources.snippet: FWKV (Feed-forward Weighted Key Value) is a small recurrent language model architecture proposed in May 2026 by FlameF0X. It began as a side project inspired by RWKV, then turned into something faster than any dense or MoE Transformer of similar size on ordinary CPUs.

sources.title: TinyMoE 100M 2x8 Retrained by FlameF0X - llm-explorer.com
sources.snippet: TinyMoE 100M 2x8 Retrained is an open-source 100m LLM by FlameF0X. VRAM 0.4GB, 1K context. Compare benchmarks, capabilities, and deployment details on LLM Explorer.
